title: Open Charge Map – Canadian and US charging locations (open-licensed providers only)
license: CC BY 4.0 for Open Charge Map contributors’ data; AddÉnergie CC BY 3.0; Greems CC0 (each station names its provider and licence). Open Charge Map terms: https://openchargemap.org/site/about/terms
attribution: Charging locations from Open Charge Map (openchargemap.org) and its contributors, licensed CC BY 4.0, plus open data from AddÉnergie (CC BY 3.0) and Greems (CC0) via Open Charge Map. Changed: filtered to public stations and merged with the AFDC data (duplicates removed).
via: Open Charge Map API v3 (api.openchargemap.io), about 6 requests a month for both countries (5,000-record pages)
notes: Owner decisions B77 and B78 (2026-11-18), docs/plan/DESIGN-6.md and DESIGN-7.md D1. Pulled monthly per country by .github/workflows/charger-refresh.yml (npm run fetch:ocm [-- --country=us], then import:ocm). Raw pulls are git-ignored; sources/ocm-<cc>/FETCHED.json records each pull. OCM’s copies of AFDC records (data provider 2) are not fetched.
